purpose: Recheck 100 precise single-blocker Career rows against source-local evidence, distinguishing absence of local quantifier evidence from actual source-condition defects.

selection.rule: all 45 pair/group singles + all 28 closed-category singles + all 12 source-compound singles + all 8 valence-state singles + all 5 open-functional singles + earliest 2 open-valence singles

evidence_catalog.finding: Career repeatedly uses broad `见煞/有煞/煞曜同度` alongside named-member examples. This supports closed category identity but does not, within the selected target clauses, establish a reusable ANY/ALL/N_OF activation default. No domain-wide default is applied.

Selected pair shorthands `昌曲/空劫/魁钺/辅弼/火铃/羊陀` occur under 同度、同会、见、会、照射、朝拱 relations, but the target clauses generally do not state whether one member or both members realize the shorthand. Relation and internal realization remain separate.
Surfaces such as `煞忌刑耗/煞忌/煞刑诸曜/刑煞曜/煞耗诸曜` are source compounds. The selected clauses provide outcome statements but no explicit internal AND/OR algebra.
`吉/凶/见吉/见凶` are whole-configuration judgments in the selected clauses; the source supplies outcomes but no reusable operational scoring criterion.

evidence_catalog.excerpt: 太阴会科文诸曜……所谓科文诸曜，乃指昌曲、龙凤、天才、化科而言。……太阴与空劫同会，有科文诸曜合，可突破行业成规……
evidence_catalog.finding: CA06-593 contains two independently unresolved semantic surfaces: 空劫 realization and 科文 activation. The latter blocker was missing from closure v0.9 and is restored.

evidence_catalog.excerpt: 唯不喜昌曲化忌，则其社会地位终有限度。
evidence_catalog.finding: The clause does not name whether 文昌 or 文曲 carries 化忌; carrier ambiguity must remain explicit.

evidence_catalog.excerpt: 巳亥巨门化禄、化权，又见魁钺，主受异族提拔而发家。
evidence_catalog.finding: The same-star 化禄、化权 list is not a simultaneous conjunction.
Existing Career critic precedent treats source `化禄、化权者` as two alternative branches rather than requiring one star to carry both transformations; CA08-702 is repaired consistently.
The two canonical IDs map to the same 七杀 support sentence and effect. Existing duplicate alias is confirmed; no ID is deleted in this unit.
`刑曜/桃花/桃花诸曜` selected clauses do not provide a globally closed functional-category membership table; open functional status remains.
Selected `吉曜` clauses use favorable-valence shorthand without a global closed member list; open valence status remains.

Contrast control: the already-resolved CA03-228 explicitly states `火铃二曜，均足以...`, showing the level of local evidence required before the project accepts clause-local ANY. No comparable explicit member-sufficiency statement was found for the selected unresolved pair rows.

Four selected rows carry historical `paragraph_scope` metadata that crossed a section boundary: CA07-609 is a 天同 rule mislabeled 太阴; CA08-701/702/703 are 巨门 rules mislabeled 天相. The new artifact records source-scope overrides without rewriting historical audit files.
